title: 3-Phase BL0906 Energy Metering Schematic
desc:
I need a complete schematic that lets the BL0906 energy-meter IC into a three-phase design and talk to it through a standalone STM32F103CBT6. The STM32 only has one job: grab raw registers from the BL0906, crunch RMS voltage and current, active power, active energy, fault flags and line frequency, then pass the results to my main controller (an ESP32) over SPI, which is the fixed interface for this project.

Key electrical details
• Current input must accept either conventional CTs or voltage-output sensors through a jumper-selectable.
• Voltage sensing is handled by a ZMPT101B module.  
• I want a well-calibrated passive filter stage on every phase to tame mains transients and high-frequency noise before they reach the BL0906. Keep the cut-off practical for 50/60 Hz metering accuracy while giving good surge immunity.
• Calibration option required for accuracy.

What I expect from you
• A clear, production-ready schematic (PDF + editable file in KiCad ).  
• Annotated BOM with part numbers that are easy to source.  
• Brief design notes explaining CT burden selection, jumper logic and the passive filter design so I can tweak values if my sensor mix changes later.

title: Open  Textbook
desc:

Accuracy, pedagogical clarity, and consistent tone are essential throughout.

After the manuscript is complete, the work extends to page design and accessibility: clean, responsive typography, navigable headings, alt-text on every figure, and a hyperlinked table of contents. Deliverables  
• Structured manuscript with all chapters, end-of-chapter problems, and answer key  
• Source files for text, images, and diagrams, clearly organised for future updates  
• Styled templates or CSS/TeX files that generate identical page numbers across formats  
• Final PDF, ePub, and print-ready files that pass accessibility checkers (e.g., EPUBCheck, PAC 3)  
• A brief build guide so the files can be regenerated by any instructor in the future

Acceptance criteria  
1. Content free of factual errors, plagiarism, and non-licensed assets  
2. Readability score appropriate to the agreed academic level  
3. All links, cross-references, and index entries resolve correctly in each format

I’m happy to invest in Google Ads—especially a well-structured Shopping campaign—but I’m also open to strategic pushes on Facebook and Instagram if they can profitably move the needle.

Here’s what I need from you:

• Set up (or audit and refine) the Google Shopping feed so the two products surface correctly and attract clicks.

If you’re confident you can turn paid traffic into Shopify revenue, let’s talk strategy and timelines.

title: Terjemah Kontrak Kerja Spanyol-ID
desc:

Ruang lingkup:
• Terjemahkan keseluruhan teks kontrak kerja tanpa mengubah struktur pasal atau penomorannya.
• Pertahankan istilah hukum spesifik; bila ada padanan yang lazim dipakai di Indonesia, sertakan di dalam kurung.
• Simpan tata letak, judul bab, tabel, dan tanda tangan sebagaimana sumber aslinya.

Keluaran yang saya butuhkan:
1. File terjemahan akhir dalam DOCX dan PDF.
2. Daftar istilah kunci Spanyol-Indonesia yang dipakai, sebagai referensi pengecekan.
3. Catatan singkat (maks. 1 halaman) tentang keputusan penerjemahan untuk frasa hukum yang sulit.

Kerahasiaan dokumen sangat penting. Harap lampirkan contoh pekerjaan serupa atau sertifikasi penerjemah hukum jika tersedia. Saya menargetkan penyelesaian dalam waktu cepat namun tetap mengutamakan ketelitian.
